home.aboutP1: Approximately Up is a space simulation adventure game focused on creative spacecraft construction and exploration. Players can build everything from reliable spacecraft to chaotic flying machines using modular components.
home.aboutP2: The game combines engineering creativity, exploration, multiplayer cooperation, and mission challenges. Players can continuously expand their ships, discover new possibilities, and create unique space experiences.
home.finalDescription: From your first spacecraft frame to complex multiplayer missions, our community wiki helps you build better ships and explore deeper space.

guide.subtitle: From your first garage build to Moonstep deliveries — every tutorial in one place.
guide.intro: Welcome to the Approximately Up guides hub. This Steam space sim lets you bolt together modular ships, wire logic circuits, and fly to the Moon with up to four friends in online co-op. The demo is live now, with the full release planned for August 2026. Whether you are launching from Earth for the first time or chasing package missions across multiple worlds, these guides walk you through the systems that matter most.
